neet_phy_u20_t11_1.working: By definition, the figure of merit is the current needed to produce one division of deflection, k = I/θ.

neet_phy_u20_t11_4.working: A: exact G = RS/(R−S), so A-I. B: k = E/((R+G)θ), so B-II. C: sensitivity is the reciprocal of k, so C-III. D: when R ≫ G, G ≈ S, so D-IV.

neet_phy_u20_t11_5.working: A is true: a high series resistance is used. B is false: an even initial deflection is chosen so that half is a whole number. C is true: smaller k means more sensitive. D is true: an accumulator keeps the emf steady. E is false: G = S holds only approximately, when R ≫ G. So A, C and D.
